meta.name: funnel-strategy
meta.description: Maps your company's GTM motion (PLG, SLG, or Hybrid) to concrete funnel stages with inputs, outputs, and qualification criteria per stage. Detects motion type from website + Exa research, then produces pre-close + post-close stage definitions, the FETE mapping (Fit / Engagement / Tier / Eligibility), and closed-lost re-entry paths. Triggers - "funnel strategy", "funnel stages", "pipeline stages", "sales process", "lead qualification", "GTM motion mapping", or any work defining how leads flow through the business. Upstream - recommended company-context, icp-research. Downstream - feeds lifecycle-marketing, outreach-emails, content-strategy. NOT for lead scoring logic (use /lead-scoring) or lifecycle email campaigns (use /lifecycle-marketing).
